scope: Proposition 9.10 (Comparison of sampled configurations) of the manuscript “Uniform real Lipschitz surfaces on the triangular lattice” (preprints/Uniform-real-Lipschitz-surfaces-on-the-triangular-lattice-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 232 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dce5ae39087f446a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 86. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are C < ∞ and R0 < ∞ such that the following holds for R ≥ R0. Take two domains containing B12R, with observers outside that disk, and any two external records ϕ, ϕ′ at radius 4R having positive hookup probability. For every event H determined by the initially unoriented ΘR, with the same specified geometric incident-edge label in the two experiments and no conditioning on the landing side, C−1 P′ (H | Φ′ 4R = ϕ′ , Z′σ ) ≤ P(H | Φ4R = ϕ, Zσ ) ≤ CP′ (H | Φ′ 4R = ϕ′ , Z′σ ). (G7) The constant is independent of R and of additional unused annuli outside radius 4R.
